set multiplot layout 2,2 title 'L2 Cache Performance Monitor' margins 0.08,0.96,0.10,0.90 spacing 0.12,0.15
set title 'Hit Rate vs Miss Rate'
set xlabel 'cycle'
set ylabel 'Percentage %'
set yrange [0:100]
set key bottom right
plot $hitrate with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#3b6fd6' title 'Hit Rate', $missrate with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#d64545' title 'Miss Rate'
set title 'Outstanding requests (MSHR proxy)'
set xlabel 'cycle'
set ylabel 'count'
set yrange [*:*]
unset key
plot $outstanding with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#3b6fd6' notitle
set title 'Cumulative completed requests'
set xlabel 'cycle'
set ylabel 'count'
set yrange [*:*]
unset key
plot $completed with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#3b6fd6' notitle
set title 'Per-request latency'
set xlabel 'request #'
set ylabel 'cycles'
set yrange [*:*]
unset key
plot $latency with points pt 7 ps 0.4 lc rgb '#6b45d6' notitle
unset multiplot

set title 'Hit Rate vs Miss Rate'
set xlabel 'cycle'
set ylabel 'Percentage %'
set yrange [0:100]
set key bottom right
plot $hitrate with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#3b6fd6' title 'Hit Rate', $missrate with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#d64545' title 'Miss Rate'
set title 'Outstanding requests (MSHR proxy)'
set xlabel 'cycle'
set ylabel 'count'
set yrange [*:*]
unset key
plot $outstanding with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#3b6fd6' notitle
set title 'Cumulative completed requests'
set xlabel 'cycle'
set ylabel 'count'
set yrange [*:*]

set ylabel 'cycles'
set yrange [*:*]
unset key

set multiplot layout 2,2 title 'L2 Cache Performance Monitor' margins 0.08,0.96,0.10,0.90 spacing 0.12,0.15
set title 'Hit Rate vs Miss Rate'
set xlabel 'cycle'
set ylabel 'Percentage %'
set yrange [0:100]
set key bottom right
plot $hitrate with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#3b6fd6' title 'Hit Rate', $missrate with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#d64545' title 'Miss Rate'
set title 'Outstanding requests (MSHR proxy)'
set xlabel 'cycle'
set ylabel 'count'
set yrange [*:*]
unset key
plot $outstanding with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#3b6fd6' notitle
set title 'Cumulative completed requests'
set xlabel 'cycle'
set ylabel 'count'
set yrange [*:*]
unset key
plot $completed with lines lw 2 lc rgb '#3b6fd6' notitle
set title 'Per-request latency'
set xlabel 'request #'
set ylabel 'cycles'
set yrange [*:*]
unset key
plot $latency with points pt 7 ps 0.4 lc rgb '#6b45d6' notitle
